Name: Dor
ModernLocation: Unknown; on the coast south of Mount Carmel
Description: A coastal town in Manasseh's portion, whose Canaanite king joined Jabin's alliance against Joshua, and which Manasseh failed to take. It remained a Canaanite town on the coast.
BiblicalSignificance: Dor is a coastal town Manasseh could not take, left among the unconquered cities.
